name: core-runtime-limits-tail-wave16-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture exercises deterministic local System.Limits current and maximum getters only; it makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

evidence.notes: Asserts a stable nonnegative local async-call count and its paired limit.
Asserts repeated async-call getter identity in the same local execution.
Asserts a stable nonnegative local async-job count against its limit.
Asserts a stable nonnegative local batch-job count against its limit.
Asserts a stable nonnegative local DML-row count against its limit.
Asserts a stable nonnegative local DML-statement count against its limit.
Asserts a stable nonnegative local email-invocation count.
Asserts the local async-call ceiling is paired with and at least its current count.
Asserts repeated async-call limit getter identity in the same local execution.
Asserts the local async-job ceiling is paired with its current count.
Asserts the local batch-job ceiling is paired with its current count.
Asserts the local DML-row ceiling is paired with its current count.
Asserts the local DML-statement ceiling is paired with its current count.
Asserts the local publish-immediate-DML ceiling is paired with its current count.

source.content: Integer asyncCalls = Limits.getAsyncCalls(); Integer asyncCallsAgain = Limits.getAsyncCalls(); Integer asyncJobs = Limits.getAsyncJobs(); Integer batchJobs = Limits.getBatchJobs(); Integer dmlRows = Limits.getDmlRows(); Integer dmlStatements = Limits.getDmlStatements(); Integer emailInvocations = Limits.getEmailInvocations(); Integer maxAsyncCalls = Limits.getLimitAsyncCalls(); Integer maxAsyncCallsAgain = Limits.getLimitAsyncCalls(); Integer maxAsyncJobs = Limits.getLimitAsyncJobs(); Integer maxBatchJobs = Limits.getLimitBatchJobs(); Integer maxDmlRows = Limits.getLimitDmlRows(); Integer maxDmlStatements = Limits.getLimitDmlStatements(); Integer publishUsed = Limits.getPublishImmediateDML(); Integer maxPublish = Limits.getLimitPublishImmediateDML(); System.assertEquals(asyncCalls, asyncCallsAgain); System.assertEquals(maxAsyncCalls, maxAsyncCallsAgain); System.assert(asyncCalls >= 0); System.assert(asyncJobs >= 0); System.assert(batchJobs >= 0); System.assert(dmlRows >= 0); System.assert(dmlStatements >= 0); System.assert(emailInvocations >= 0); System.assert(publishUsed >= 0); System.assert(maxAsyncCalls >= asyncCalls); System.assert(maxAsyncJobs >= asyncJobs); System.assert(maxBatchJobs >= batchJobs); System.assert(maxDmlRows >= dmlRows); System.assert(maxDmlStatements >= dmlStatements); System.assert(maxPublish >= publishUsed);
